svg.text: The twin scans its own build: the 4-bead tetrahedron (0.4 mm across) is one blob at these wavelengths
maximum-intensity projections of the matched-field image (brighter = more likely an object there); white dots = the true object
Exact glass-chamber fields, six gates, every gate pair, point scatterers (Born); the chamber-only transfer is calibrated away; measurement noise added.
